fusions.name: Gannet's Plunge
fusions.desc: You plunge up to 7 tiles onto the target. It deals 13 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Squall Wingbeat
fusions.desc: A wingbeat drives a squall through a cone 3 tiles deep that deals 7 damage to every enemy in it, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Tethered Diver
fusions.desc: Sends out a cormorant for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it dives on an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 3 damage, and each kill it makes restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Petrel Patter

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground
and your dodge chance rises while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you cross it 15% faster than ground, and from silver your dodge chance rises by 6% while you are on it.
